g.text: BOM v1 line 97: td = CT / 175 nF + 0.5 ms

g.desc: BOM v1 line 97: td = CT / 175 nF + 0.5 ms

g.text: 1. Function: MaskROM entry from the buttons (BRD-035, BRD-043 must; board ADR 0009): Power and Vol-

g.desc: 1. Function: MaskROM entry from the buttons (BRD-035, BRD-043 must; board ADR 0009): Power and Vol-

g.text: held at a cold power-on pull eMMC_D0 low, so the BootROM falls through to USB download.

g.desc: held at a cold power-on pull eMMC_D0 low, so the BootROM falls through to USB download.

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted (always on, vcca1v8_pmu); the gate pull-down holds the FET off

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted (always on, vcca1v8_pmu); the gate pull-down holds the FET off

g.text: and D0 free while vcca1v8_pmu is down (feature-block record 48).

g.desc: and D0 free while vcca1v8_pmu is down (feature-block record 48).

g.text: 3. Window: TPS3808G01 on vcca1v8_pmu, SENSE 280 kΩ / 100 kΩ (trip 1.54 V), CT 390 nF: td 2.23 s

g.desc: 3. Window: TPS3808G01 on vcca1v8_pmu, SENSE 280 kΩ / 100 kΩ (trip 1.54 V), CT 390 nF: td 2.23 s

g.text: typical, 1.21-3.43 s (the ±40 % of the 130 pF and 180 nF rows, td linear in CT: SBVS050N §7.3.2,

g.desc: typical, 1.21-3.43 s (the ±40 % of the 130 pF and 180 nF rows, td linear in CT: SBVS050N §7.3.2,

g.text: 220 nA to 1.23 V; CT ±10 %); WINDOW_N is RESET, open drain, 100 kΩ to vcca1v8_pmu; MR open.

g.desc: 220 nA to 1.23 V; CT ±10 %); WINDOW_N is RESET, open drain, 100 kΩ to vcca1v8_pmu; MR open.

g.text: 4. Logic on vcca1v8_pmu (Schmitt inputs): 1G57 In2 = PWRON through the BAT54 with 100 kΩ up, In1

g.desc: 4. Logic on vcca1v8_pmu (Schmitt inputs): 1G57 In2 = PWRON through the BAT54 with 100 kΩ up, In1

g.text: = GND, In0 = Vol-: high when both are pressed; 1G58 In2 = WINDOW_N, In1 = VCC, In0 = that: high

g.desc: = GND, In0 = Vol-: high when both are pressed; 1G58 In2 = WINDOW_N, In1 = VCC, In0 = that: high

g.text: only inside the window, into the DMG1012T gate (100 kΩ down); its drain pulls D0 through 1 kΩ.

g.desc: only inside the window, into the DMG1012T gate (100 kΩ down); its drain pulls D0 through 1 kΩ.

g.text: 5. Simulated (sim/maskrom): D0 held 1.20-3.42 s after RESETB, never at resume, normal boot

g.desc: 5. Simulated (sim/maskrom): D0 held 1.20-3.42 s after RESETB, never at resume, normal boot

g.text: untouched; the 1 kΩ stub costs 0.04 V of HS200 margin. A warm restart keeps vcca1v8_pmu up and

g.desc: untouched; the 1 kΩ stub costs 0.04 V of HS200 margin. A warm restart keeps vcca1v8_pmu up and

g.text: does not reopen the window: MaskROM through the buttons needs a full power-off.

g.desc: does not reopen the window: MaskROM through the buttons needs a full power-off.

g.text: 6. PCB: the 1 kΩ sits on the D0 trace with a stub of 3 mm or less (BOM v1 line 35).

g.desc: 6. PCB: the 1 kΩ sits on the D0 trace with a stub of 3 mm or less (BOM v1 line 35).

g.text: eMMC D0 pull: DMG1012T, 1 kΩ (BOM v1 line 35)

g.desc: eMMC D0 pull: DMG1012T, 1 kΩ (BOM v1 line 35)
